description: Schema for an immutable manifest identifying the definition set of one MAVLink-M release. Each release has one canonical manifest, so every build of a release reports the same digest, whatever revision of the included definitions it is generated against.

definitionName.description: Stable name of the definition set.

definitionRelease.description: Human-readable release label. Compatibility is determined from the file digests, not this label.

files.description: Every definition file needed to reproduce the supported semantics, including included MAVLink XML at the revision the release pins, related MAVLink XML, metadata schemas, and external dictionaries.

role.description: How this file contributes to the definition set. related-dialect is MAVLink XML that the dialect does not include but that an implementation builds alongside it for a feature that uses it, such as development.xml for operator control.

uri.description: Immutable URI for the exact file.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the exact uncompressed file.
